audience: hiring teams that run skills assessments for candidates in their own Testlify workspace

useCases.title: Check the connected workspace and organization
useCases.text: Read the profile and organization of your connected Testlify workspace. Use it to confirm which account the assistant reads.

useCases.title: Review the assessments in your workspace
useCases.text: List assessment summaries in your workspace, a page at a time. Then read the candidates for one assessment.

useCases.title: Summarize candidates for one assessment
useCases.text: Read the candidates for one assessment and summarize them for a hiring manager. Proctoring, identity media and detailed result reports are not returned.
